name: BSP_AvoidZone_TangentCorners
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Two mirrored walks from the corner the blocked edge starts at, each carrying the bearing to the far point minus the bearing of the edge leaving the walking corner, moved across each corner's +1Ch turn (00422752 forward, 00422D58 backward). A corner is accepted where that angle changes sign and the exactly recomputed angle has the right sign (004228AE, 00422EDE); it is the tangent point from the far point. The published point is that corner pushed `margin` units (floored at 1.0 by 00422515) along the normalised sum of the unit vectors to its two neighbours, with the perpendicular fallback at 00422A80 / 00423012, and pulled back through 00417EF0 when the margin exceeds ten units (00422B85, 00423136). far_side_hint >= 0 runs the forward pass (004226ED) and <= 0 the backward one (00422CF9); near_corner_hint >= 0 caps the steps. Return +1 forward only, -1 backward only, 0 both or neither. Sole caller 009E3040 at 009E3105. docs/AVOID_ZONE_GEOMETRY.md; reports/avoid_zone_geometry.json.
